# PickKR

> Korea Travel Beauty Guide & Weekly Top 20 Best Sellers from Lotte Duty Free, MISSHA, and DAISO Korea.

PickKR tracks weekly best-selling Korean beauty and skincare products across major traveler shopping channels and publishes practical shopping, tax-refund, and airport carry-on guides in four languages (`en`, `ja`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`).

## Supported Locales
- English: `/en`
- Japanese: `/ja`
- Simplified Chinese: `/zh-CN`
- Traditional Chinese: `/zh-TW`

## Weekly Top 20 Rankings
- Lotte Duty Free Best Sellers: `/en/channel/lottedfs`, `/ja/channel/lottedfs`, `/zh-CN/channel/lottedfs`, `/zh-TW/channel/lottedfs`
- MISSHA Korea Best Sellers: `/en/channel/missha`, `/ja/channel/missha`, `/zh-CN/channel/missha`, `/zh-TW/channel/missha`
- DAISO Korea Beauty Best Sellers: `/en/channel/daisomall`, `/ja/channel/daisomall`, `/zh-CN/channel/daisomall`, `/zh-TW/channel/daisomall`

## Travel Shopping Guides
- Guides Index: `/en/guides`, `/ja/guides`, `/zh-CN/guides`, `/zh-TW/guides`

## Sitemaps & Policies
- XML Sitemap: `/sitemap.xml`
- Robots: `/robots.txt`
